changes.comment: BREAKING: Review: external consumers must implement the required cold readTranscript provider method, persist thread.path with the native session checkpoint, and handle RuntimeAdmission plus stable RuntimeTurn objects instead of public app-server Turn IDs. Codex now reads bounded provider-neutral pages from active, archived, compressed, and history-base native rollouts; request uncertainty is ambiguous, folded aliases converge before settlement, and stop tears down transport before draining every started admission. No rebuild is required: existing Codex rollouts and Dreamux checkpoints remain readable, with provider-native rediscovery when a stored locator is absent or stale.
